records.name: README.md
records.text:
DJConnect

Your music. Your DJ.

Your personal music DJ in Home Assistant. Ask for music and enjoy DJ contributions from an available DJConnect app, supported device or Home Assistant Assist.

Open DJConnect in HACS

English · Nederlands · Deutsch · Français · Español

This branch describes 4.0.0-rc.1, a candidate, not an installed-release claim. Installed 3.3.1? Follow the stable setup guide. Check your installed version in HACS before following the wizard steps.

Make it your session
Ask for music without searching through menus.
Let your DJ share music stories and announcements.
Choose the DJ Persona and mood for your session.
What you need
Home Assistant and HACS, plus a configured Assist pipeline. The 4.0 candidate needs an available conversation agent; STT/TTS are optional for setup. Stable 3.3.1 needs a pipeline with both STT and TTS: see its versioned guide.
Choose a music route: Spotify Direct needs Spotify Premium, your own Spotify Developer app Client ID and an external HTTPS Home Assistant URL; Nabu Casa is recommended. Music Assistant needs a configured installation and usable player. You can also choose Later / manual without Spotify login.
Choose how to connect: use an available DJConnect app/device, or use Assist without pairing one. Pair local devices on the same LAN; ESP32 needs 2.4 GHz WiFi. Speech availability depends on the selected route and actual client capabilities.
Install
Open HACS. If needed, use Custom repositories, add https://github.com/pcvantol/djconnect and select category Integration.
Install DJConnect from HACS.
Restart Home Assistant.
Go to Settings → Devices & services → Add integration → DJConnect.
Start your first session
Choose Assist, a local device or an app in the wizard.
Follow the pairing screen when applicable (Assist skips pairing): iPhone/Watch use a QR flow; macOS uses the shown Home Assistant URL and code. ESP32/Pi use local pairing. Optional Bluetooth setup only supplies ESP32 WiFi.
On 4.0, choose an existing Profile or create one. Reusing a Profile keeps its music connection; a new Profile can choose Spotify Direct, Music Assistant or Later. Stable 3.3.1 asks for the backend before creating its Profile.
Open the connected client and start a DJ session, or select DJConnect DJ in your Assist configuration. A deferred music route must be configured before playback.

Step-by-step setup · Spotify Direct · Help

Need a hand?
Assist missing: configure the prerequisites for your installed version.
Spotify login does not return: copy the exact redirect URI from the wizard into Spotify Developer Dashboard; update it and reauthorize after an external URL change.
Local pairing fails: check the LAN and use the current six-digit code.
Generic HA icon: redownload in HACS, restart HA and refresh the frontend cache.

More help · Documentation · Website · Source

records.name: info.md
records.text:
DJConnect

Your music. Your DJ.

Your personal music DJ in Home Assistant: ask for music, enjoy DJ contributions and choose your session mood through an available client or Assist.

Install with HACS, restart Home Assistant, then open Settings → Devices & services → Add integration → DJConnect.

This branch describes candidate 4.0.0-rc.1; check your installed HACS version. Stable 3.3.1 requires Assist STT + TTS; the candidate requires an available conversation agent and makes speech optional for setup. Spotify Direct needs Premium, your Developer Client ID and external HTTPS. Music Assistant needs a configured player. Later/manual defers music setup. Assist needs no separately paired client.

Setup and five languages

DJConnect is MIT-licensed; third-party licenses remain applicable. Spotify is a trademark of Spotify AB. DJConnect is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Spotify AB.
